about.about_me_item_1: My name is Alan Sousa da Silva, I'm {{ age }} years old and I'm from Beberibe, Ceará. I'm graduated in Computer Science from the Federal University Of Ceará (Universidade Federal do Ceará). I grew up in the countryside of Beberibe, in the Córrego do Pântano community, and I lived there until I was 15 years old, when I moved to the downtown of Beberibe to study at the vocational school. I've two younger sisters, Laís e Lara, my parents Franscisco e Elizangela, working as self-employed and a teacher, respectively.
about.hobbies_item_1: Currently, I have been leading a healthier life, practicing bodybuilding and jiu-jitsu, besides trying to maintain a more balanced diet. I like to cook, usually simpler dishes, but for me, it's something relaxing, just like I enjoy cleaning the house, washing the dishes, and organizing things, I feel good doing this (living alone makes me like these things).
about.hobbies_item_2: I like to play video games, here my Steam profile, mainly pixel art games. From time to time, I like to buy a puzzle to test my patience, the most beautiful one I assembled was The Starry Night by Van Gogh, with 1000 pieces. Sometimes I invite children in the neighborhood (sisters and cousins) to play some card games (UNO, Old Maid, among others) and video games (PICO PARK, Overcooked, Monster Meals, among others).
about.hobbies_item_3: Regarding studies, I have been focusing a lot on learning English, I have been studying on the Fluency Academy platform, and this time I am managing to learn more consistently and I have been enjoying it a lot.
